name: @singularity/plugin-packages-resource-protocol
description: The live-resource wire protocol's failure vocabulary, shared by the resource runtime (server, central) and the live-state client: the sub-error reasons (contract-mismatch included), the contract verdict (skew / same-build / unknown), the sub-error frame and HTTP error body, the client build-graph header, and ResourceContractError — the typed throw a params decode raises when a subscription does not match the declaration.
